name: Kimi Sae Ireba
source:
Hundreds of years later, humans and Heflites coexist on a hidden planet near Earth. Finding a mate is the goal, but will something like that really help her break free from the deep darkness she experienced as a child? "...This feeling...is not an obsession..."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2534630/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
数百年后，人类和赫夫利特人在地球附近的一个隐藏星球上共存。寻找伴侣是目标，但这样的事情真的能帮助她摆脱童年经历的深深黑暗吗？“……这种感觉……不是执念……”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2534630/]Steam[/url]]
